description: Binary assertions for Property Profile Enricher output quality. Karpathy self-improvement loop.
origin: Forked from NextAutomation Property Profile Enricher v1.0, enhanced for Brevard County FL.

tests.prompt: Enrich parcel 25-37-22-00-00123.0-0000.00 in foreclosure mode with standard depth. Output JSON.
tests.expected_output: Complete enrichment result with owner, tax, liens, permits, comps stages

assertions.description: Output is valid JSON (parseable without errors)
Result contains 'stages' object with at least 3 sub-objects
Result contains sale_type field matching 'foreclosure'
Result contains enriched_at timestamp in ISO format
Result contains elapsed_seconds as a positive number

tests.prompt: Enrich a known Brevard parcel and verify owner stage output structure.
tests.expected_output: Owner profile with name, type, confidence score

assertions.description: Owner stage has owner_name field (string or null)
Owner stage has owner_type from enum: individual|entity|trust|government|null
Owner stage has confidence between 0.0 and 1.0
Owner stage has photo_url field
Owner stage has parcel_id field matching Brevard format or input

tests.prompt: Enrich parcel and verify tax assessment data structure.
tests.expected_output: Tax profile with assessed value, delinquency status, exemptions

assertions.description: Tax stage has assessed_value field (number or null)
Tax stage has delinquent boolean field
Tax stage has homestead boolean field
Tax stage has exemptions as array
Tax stage confidence between 0.0 and 1.0

tests.prompt: Enrich parcel in foreclosure mode with deep depth and judgment_amount=150000. Verify synthesis.
tests.expected_output: Synthesis with max_bid, bid_judgment_ratio, and BID/REVIEW/SKIP action

assertions.description: Synthesis has action from enum: BID|REVIEW|SKIP
Synthesis valuation has max_bid as positive number
Synthesis valuation has bid_judgment_ratio between 0.0 and 5.0
Synthesis has red_flags as array
Synthesis has overall_confidence between 0.0 and 1.0

tests.prompt: Enrich parcel in off_market mode with deep depth. Verify motivation score and CONTACT/MONITOR action.
tests.expected_output: Synthesis with motivation_score 0-100 and CONTACT or MONITOR action

assertions.description: Synthesis has motivation_score between 0 and 100
Synthesis action is CONTACT or MONITOR for off_market mode
Synthesis sale_type is 'off_market'
Synthesis does NOT contain max_bid for off_market mode
Synthesis green_flags is array (may be empty)
